environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application running in a Docker container (mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0) on ECS Fargate. Container runs as root. The /var/app/uploads and /var/app/preview-cache directories are on the same ext4 volume. No filesystem restrictions on symlink creation. The application is exposed via an AWS ALB with default configuration (no managed rule groups attached). Response headers are default ASP.NET Core headers only.

config.network: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF
